entries.name: FFmpeg.org
entries.description: Where it all starts.

entries.name: Filters
entries.description: Docs for FFmpeg's powerful filter chains (scaling, cropping, concatenating, merging, etc.). This is one of my most visited links when working with FFmpeg.

entries.name: Man page
entries.description: Official FFmpeg man page.

entries.name: Wiki & Bug Tracker
entries.description: Lots of great info on here.

entries.name: CLI flags
entries.description: A comprehensive list of all FFmpeg commandline flags. Really useful for searching random flags that you come across in the wild.

entries.name: fluent-ffmpeg
entries.description: A fluent API to FFmpeg. If you only use one tool from this list, it should be this one.

entries.name: ffmpeg-probe
entries.description: Wrapper around ffprobe for getting info about media files.

entries.name: ffmpeg-concat
entries.description: Concats a list of videos together using FFmpeg with sexy OpenGL transitions.

entries.name: editly
entries.description: Declarative video editing tool and library with slick animations and transitions.

entries.name: ffmpeg-generate-video-preview
entries.description: Generates an attractive image strip or GIF preview from a video.

entries.name: ffmpeg-extract-frame
entries.description: Extracts a single frame from a video.

entries.name: ffmpeg-extract-frames
entries.description: Extracts screenshots from a video using FFmpeg.

entries.name: gif-extract-frames
entries.description: Extracts frames from GIFs including inter-frame coalescing.

entries.name: ffmpeg-extract-audio
entries.description: Extracts an audio stream from a media file.

entries.name: ffmpeg-on-progress
entries.description: Utility for robustly reporting progress with fluent-ffmpeg.

entries.name: ffmpeg.js
entries.description: Port of FFmpeg to JavaScript via Emscripten. Allows for limited FFmpeg use on the client-side.

entries.name: ffmpeg-static
entries.description: Provides static FFmpeg binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Very useful for CI testing.

entries.name: tangerine
entries.description: Webcam streaming service using Node.js, FFmpeg, WebSockets, and Lad.

entries.name: ffparser
entries.description: Parse input stream by frames directly into your code as a buffer.

entries.name: ffmpeg-gl-transition
entries.description: FFmpeg filter for applying GLSL transitions between video streams (gl-transitions).

entries.name: simplest ffmpeg mobile
entries.description: FFmpeg examples for Android and iOS.

entries.name: ijkplayer
entries.description: Android / iOS video player based on FFmpeg.

entries.name: How to Write a Video Player in Less Than 1k Lines
Learn FFmpeg libav the Hard Way
Applying OpenGL Shaders with FFmpeg
entries.description: And follow-up.

entries.name: FFmpeg Cookbook
entries.description: Task-first cookbook of tested ffmpeg one-liners (compress, trim, GIF, audio extraction).
